name: Silas Crow

abilities.name: Sneak Attack
abilities.description: A precise strike from the shadows targeting vital points

abilities.name: Vanish
abilities.description: Melts into shadows, becoming nearly impossible to detect

abilities.name: Poisoned Blade
abilities.description: Applies a debilitating poison to weapon that weakens the target

appearance.distinctive_features: Several small scars on hands, missing tip of left pinky finger

personality.demeanor: Friendly and approachable when beneficial, always watching for angles and exits
personality.speaking_style: Smooth and conversational, uses humor to deflect, changes story depending on audience

beliefs: Everyone is out for themselves; honesty is just bad tactics
Loyalty is a commodity that can be bought and sold
The world owes me nothing, so I'll take what I need
philosophy.approach_to_conflict: Avoids direct confrontation whenever possible. Prefers ambush, deception, or simply disappearing. Will betray allies if survival or significant profit is at stake. Only fights when cornered or when the odds are overwhelmingly in his favor.

hidden: Stolen noble's signet ring (worth a fortune, too hot to sell yet)
Small bag of gold coins (from his last 'job')

secrets: Betrayed his former thieves' guild and they're actively hunting him
Real name is Marcus Thorne, changed identity to escape past crimes
Owes a dangerous debt to a crime lord in the capital
backstory: Born in the slums, Silas learned early that survival meant taking what others wouldn't miss. Rose through the ranks of a thieves' guild before betraying them for a bigger score. Now operates as a freelance thief and occasional assassin, always one step ahead of those seeking revenge.
